name: ssh-credentials
description: Installs an SSH private key and matching client config for the agent, so it can reach the hosts that key is authorized on.

settings.label: Private key file
settings.description: Host path to a key without a passphrase, dedicated to the sandbox.

settings.label: Hosts
settings.description: Host pattern the key is offered for.

settings.label: Domain suffix
settings.description: Appended to bare host names: netbird.cloud makes `ssh my-vm` reach my-vm.netbird.cloud.

settings.label: known_hosts file
settings.description: Pins the peers' host keys. Empty: trust on first use.
